div.p:
A FAMILY OF INTERCHANGEABLE ALGORITHMS BEHIND ONE INTERFACE. THE
CONTEXT HOLDS A REFERENCE TO THE INTERFACE AND DELEGATES; SWAPPING
THE CONCRETE STRATEGY CHANGES BEHAVIOUR WITHOUT TOUCHING THE
CONTEXT.
